title: Bimodule description of dg-category mapping spaces
statement:
Use the dg-category and quasi-equivalence conventions of [lem-coef-dgcat-model-structure], let $\mathsf{Hqe}$ be the ordinary localization at quasi-equivalences, and let $\operatorname{Map}_{\mathrm{qe}}(\mathcal A,\mathcal B)$ denote the mapping space from $\mathcal A$ to $\mathcal B$ in the homotopy coherent localization at quasi-equivalences. For dg categories $\mathcal C,\mathcal E$, the tensor $\mathcal C\otimes\mathcal E$ has object pairs and morphism complexes $\mathcal C(c,c')\otimes_{\mathbf Z}\mathcal E(e,e')$, with composition using the graded symmetry $x\otimes y\mapsto(-1)^{|x||y|}y\otimes x$. The opposite reverses morphism complexes and uses this symmetry in composition. Write $\mathrm{Ch}(\mathbf Z)$ for cochain complexes with their usual complexes of graded maps. Let $\mathcal A,\mathcal B$ be small dg categories over $\mathbf Z$, and choose the cofibrant replacement $Q\mathcal A\to\mathcal A$ of that node. Let $\mathcal W(\mathcal A,\mathcal B)$ have as objects dg functors $T:Q\mathcal A\otimes\mathcal B^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Ch}(\mathbf Z)$ whose restrictions $T(a,-)$ are cofibrant right $\mathcal B$-modules and are isomorphic in the derived category of right $\mathcal B$-modules to some representable $\mathcal B(-,b_a)$. A right module, its maps and its objectwise quasi-isomorphisms are as in [lem-coef-dg-module-projective-resolution]; cofibrant here means lifting against all degreewise surjective objectwise quasi-isomorphisms of modules. Morphisms in $\mathcal W$ are only the objectwise quasi-isomorphisms of bimodules. There is a natural equivalence of spaces
$$\operatorname{Map}_{\mathrm{qe}}(\mathcal A,\mathcal B)\simeq N\mathcal W(\mathcal A,\mathcal B),$$
where $N$ denotes the ordinary nerve, regarded up to weak homotopy equivalence. On connected components this identifies $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathsf{Hqe}}(\mathcal A,\mathcal B)$ with isomorphism classes of all right quasi-representable $Q\mathcal A\otimes\mathcal B^{\mathrm{op}}$-modules in the localization at objectwise quasi-isomorphisms; the cofibrancy condition on the restrictions can be omitted for this isomorphism-class formulation. A strict dg functor $F:Q\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ corresponds to the bimodule $(a,b)\mapsto\mathcal B(b,F(a))$. These identifications commute with restriction in the first variable and derived extension of scalars in the second, meaning the left adjoint of restriction on localized module categories, computed by tensoring a projective replacement with the target category's morphism bimodule. If all morphism complexes of $\mathcal A$ are homotopically flat, the isomorphism-class bijection also holds using all right quasi-representable $\mathcal A\otimes\mathcal B^{\mathrm{op}}$-modules in place of $Q\mathcal A\otimes\mathcal B^{\mathrm{op}}$-modules, with the comparison induced by restriction along $Q\mathcal A\to\mathcal A$; no fiberwise cofibrancy condition is imposed in this isomorphism-class formulation.
